LanguageData.LP_GraftRay.label: beholder ray
LanguageData.LP_GraftRay.description: The beholder eye fires a ray: necrotic ray (30 necrotic damage), petrification ray (begins petrification) or charm ray (dazed 25 seconds); the type is set when the eye is installed. 20 cells, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_GraftBreath.label: dragon breath
LanguageData.LP_GraftBreath.description: Breathe dragon breath: enemies in a 6-cell cone take 30 damage, with the element matching the breath gland's color (red fire, white cold, blue lightning, black acid, green poison). Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DeadSpeak.label: speak with dead
LanguageData.LP_DeadSpeak.description: Get close to a humanlike corpse and listen to it speak: learn 10% of the total XP of its highest skill (once per corpse; converted to adventurer XP as usual).
LanguageData.LP_VecnaFrostTouch.label: frost touch
LanguageData.LP_VecnaFrostTouch.description: The Hand of Vecna presses on an enemy: 30 cold damage and hypothermia. Cooldown 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_VecnaCommand.label: command undead
LanguageData.LP_VecnaCommand.description: The Hand of Vecna commands one enemy undead within 20 cells: for 30 seconds it turns to attack its former companions (may be resisted). Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_VecnaDominate.label: dominate person
LanguageData.LP_VecnaDominate.description: The Eye of Vecna fixes on one humanlike enemy within 20 cells: for 30 seconds it only attacks its former companions, then collapses exhausted when time is up (may be resisted). Cooldown 1 day.
